title: Are Boat Trips in Madeira Worth It in Winter?
description: Yes, on the right day. December to February brings about 20°C afternoons, low golden light and early sunsets, but more swell days and a sea of 18 to 20°C.
heroAlt: Two guests in light jackets on a boat deck looking at the Desertas islands on a winter morning
keywords: are boat trips in Madeira worth it in winter
Madeira winter weather on the water

images.prompt: Mid-morning in January, from the deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy off Madeira's south coast. Two guests in light jackets and sunglasses, seen from behind and small, sit on the grey cushions looking out over a glassy, deep blue sea to the long, flat-topped Desertas islands on the south-east horizon. Low winter sun from the side, long soft reflections on the water, a clear pale blue sky. Realistic photo, true colours, no text.
images.alt: Two guests in light jackets on a boat deck looking at the Desertas islands on a winter morning

images.prompt: A swimmer seen from behind climbing back up the stern ladder of a white motor boat on a bright winter day off Ribeira Brava, water dripping, a towel waiting on the grey seat, calm blue sea.
images.alt: Swimmer climbing back onto a white boat after a winter swim off Ribeira Brava
